name: hugmesh-user-ui-e2e
description: Playwright + playwright-bdd e2e harness for the hugmesh-user-ui federated remote. Copied from the proven hugmesh.games/e2e pattern and mirrors the merged wave-2b-1 PRs (admin-ui#39, superadmin-appstore-ui#2, login-ui#19). Ships dark (wave 2b): every cluster-dependent scenario is @cluster-tagged so the suite compiles and discovers offline without a live stack.
